description: This work is quite abstract in nature.  A large, light-colored form with softly-curving edges occupies much of the canvas.  It is mainly blue; however, a yellowish-white area fills the upper-central portion of the form.  A series of swirling blue and green lines occupies the background along the upper edge of the work.
